mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_item_count, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'PRODUCT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_count, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'MATERIAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS material_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bom) AS bom_count, SUM(CASE WHEN item_type = 'PRODUCT' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bom b WHERE b.parent_item_id = i.item_id ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS product_without_bom_count FROM item i WHERE active = 1
SELECT item_id, item_code, item_name, item_type, spec, unit, standard_price, description, active, created_at, updated_at FROM item WHERE active = 1 ORDER BY created_at DESC, item_id DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT b.bom_id, b.parent_item_id, b.component_item_id, b.required_qty, b.created_at, b.updated_at, parent_item.item_code AS parent_item_code, parent_item.item_name AS parent_item_name, component_item.item_code AS component_item_code, component_item.item_name AS component_item_name, component_item.unit AS component_unit FROM bom b JOIN item parent_item ON parent_item.item_id = b.parent_item_id JOIN item component_item ON component_item.item_id = b.component_item_id ORDER BY b.created_at DESC, b.bom_id DESC LIMIT 5
